text:
olivia: kicking off RC origination for v2.14.0-lite. want a quick sign-off matrix and rollback clause before we schedule the promo window. changing minimal surface: routing+cache key fix + batcher tweak.

mike: noted. where are the release notes?

olivia: draft in PR #4827, section called 'lite fixes' — will paste snippet in a sec. need ppl to ack: eng-platform, infra-sre, oncall.

dmitri: tagging rollout constraints — prefer 1800-2100 UTC tomorrow. low traffic slot. can we do a 10% canary for 15m then step to 50%?

olivia: yes to canary plan. canonical timeline: 10m smoke, 15m 10% canary, 30m 50%, then full 100% if metrics stable. rollback if error rate >1% OR p50 latency regresses >20%.

sarah: quick checklist from QA: regression suite passed on candidate-rc build (logs attached). we have one flaky test (embed-service timeout) marked as non-blocking.

olivia: great. mike, infra has any infra constraints on pinning artifact? we want to pin to image sha: sha256:3a7f... and gce image tag rc-v2-14-lite.

mike: infra ok with pin. I'll create the pinned artifact entry and set deploy-bot pin. also adding a fallback model variant route for low-memory hosts.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: RC candidate created: rc-v2-14-lite @ sha256:3a7f... — /pin applied to promo-window 2024-05-14T18:00:00Z -> 2024-05-14T21:00:00Z. Trigger permission: olivia, mike.

ryan_oncall: oncall ack. I'll be primary sheriff for the window. if rollback needed, I'll run the rollback playbook: /run rollback rc-v2-14-lite -> stable@sha256:2f9b... and post status.

dmitri: small operational note — please disable cross-region warmup for 5m post-promo to avoid double-cache writes.

olivia: copied. adding to promo thread checklist. also attaching the minimal rollback steps here:

olivia: ```
1) Pause traffic shift (deployment controller)
2) Trigger rollback job: kubectl apply -f rollout-fallback/stable-manifest.yaml --record
3) Invalidate cache keys for routing change: scripts/cache-invalidate --pattern "route:v2*"
4) Monitor errors/p50 for 10m, then fully resume normal traffic.
```

mike: confirming observability hooks: pinned dashboards: /dash/rc-v2-14-lite, alert: infra_error_rate_rc (>0.8%) and latency_p50_regress (>15%). I've added short-lived traces to sample requests.

sarah: QA will standby during canary, will post failing test traces in the thread.

olivia: looking for +1s to promote to promo window. please respond with :+1: or concerns.

mike: +1

dmitri: +1

ryan_oncall: +1 (sheriff ready)

sarah: +1 (QA standby)

olivia: thanks all. scheduling the promo for the window noted. I'll post the cutover reminder 30m before and invite the oncall.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: promo scheduled for 2024-05-14T18:00:00Z. Canary step automation will run unless manual hold is applied.

olivia: last note — if we hit the flaky embed timeout post-promo, rollback immediately. marking that as a fast-fail.

mike: acknowledged. will also pin a hotfix branch if we need quick patching (hotfix/rc-2-14-quick).

olivia: thread closed for now unless new blockers show up. thanks!
